cohort: The study included children born to mothers with type 1, type 2, or gestational diabetes, and a control group of children from mothers without diabetes.
finding: Offspring of mothers with pre-gestational diabetes mellitus, particularly type 2, showed a significantly higher risk of developing overweight/obesity by 8 years of age compared to offspring of mothers with gestational diabetes or control mothers.
birth_weight: Mean 1637g (SD 600g) for offspring of mothers with DM; Mean 2208g (SD 518g) for control offspring.
gest_age: Mean 32.8 weeks (SD 3.1 weeks) for offspring of mothers with DM; Mean 36.4 weeks (SD 2.2 weeks) for control offspring.
